card.name: The word "at" after a verb
card.fires_on: The word "at" right after a verb or event noun, where it introduces a place or a time ("held at", "convene at", "Sunday, Nov. 4, at 2 a.m."). It also appears in the fixed phrase "at least" after "wait".

modes.label: Place after verb

modes.label: Time or "at least"
modes.description: "at" introduces a clock time or starts the phrase "at least".
